crop.title: Crop image
crop.tip: Center the baby's face for best results
crop.guidanceFaceTip: Center the full face or profile inside the crop.
crop.guidanceFaceSubTip: Include the forehead, nose, lips, and chin with a small margin around them.
crop.guidanceHeartTip: Frame the full cardiac view before generating.
crop.guidanceHeartSubTip: Keep the heart contour visible and leave out side panels or text whenever possible.
crop.guidanceBrainTip: Crop the head so the full intracranial plane stays visible.
crop.guidanceBrainSubTip: Try to preserve the skull contour and the visible internal structures in a single frame.
crop.guidanceSpineTip: Keep the main spinal path inside the crop.
crop.guidanceSpineSubTip: Avoid cutting the vertebral curve into fragments or leaving only an isolated segment.
crop.guidanceAbdomenTip: Center the abdomen and keep the full abdominal ring visible.
crop.guidanceAbdomenSubTip: If the posterior spine or a main cavity is visible, try to keep it inside the frame.
crop.guidanceFullBodyTip: Keep the fetus' overall pose inside the crop.
crop.guidanceFullBodySubTip: Do not zoom too tightly: try to keep the head, torso, and visible limbs in the same composition.

generate.title: Generate portrait
generate.confirmSubtitle: If the baby's face is clear, press generate
generate.modePortraitDesc: Baby in outfit, ideal for parents
generate.clinicalConditionsHint: Select any diagnosed or suspected conditions
generate.qualityDark: The cropped ultrasound looks quite dark. If possible, go back and center the main structure more tightly.
generate.qualityLowContrast: The crop has low contrast. A region with clearer contours usually produces better results.
generate.qualitySubjectTooSmall: The main structure occupies too little of the crop. Zooming in a bit more should improve fidelity.
generate.qualityWarningContinue: You can still continue, but this input has a higher risk of producing an imprecise result.
generate.scanTypeAdvice2dPreferred: Heart, brain, spine, and abdomen usually work better with a 2D ultrasound that clearly shows the anatomical plane.
generate.scanTypeAdvice3d4dPreferred: Face and full-body results usually work better with a 3D/4D ultrasound where volume and contour are clearly visible.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. Images are illustrative and AI-generated. They do not replace professional medical interpretation and have no diagnostic value.
faq.q2: What types of ultrasounds does it accept?
faq.a2: Works best with 3D/4D fetal face ultrasounds. Accepts JPG, PNG, and HEIC formats up to 10MB.
faq.a3: No. Images are processed in real time and are never stored on our servers.
faq.a4: Contact us via WhatsApp to request your personal access token.
faq.a5: Between 20 and 40 seconds depending on image complexity.
